summary: Removing an item from a two-item RTree with MIN_SIZE = 1 computes the drain stack capacity using log base 1. This yields positive infinity, which casts to usize::MAX and causes Vec::with_capacity to panic. The fix clamps the logarithm base to at least 2, producing a finite capacity. The regression test added by this commit exercises this case. This plan reverses only that clamp; reproduction remains for the runner.

reversal.fixed_text: let max_depth = (original_size as f32).log(m.max(2) as f32).ceil() as usize;
reversal.parent_text: let max_depth = (original_size as f32).log(m as f32).ceil() as usize;
